text: The Divine Dragon appears as an immense ethereal being resembling pale white wood and silver bark, wielding a lightning-charged sword in a single arm.
Lady Butterfly fights using illusions, including exploding phantom butterflies and ghostly apparitions of the dead, reflecting her nature as a master of deception.

Wolf fights Genichiro Ashina three times: on the bridge, at the top of Ashina Castle, and in a final battle at a place called the Fountainhead/Silver field, each time showing further deterioration in Genichiro's methods and composure.
In the second fight at the top of Ashina Castle, Genichiro Ashina tears off his armor and wields a black-bladed bow charged with lightning.
In the final encounter, Genichiro Ashina uses the Black Mortal Blade to cut his own throat, sacrificing his body to open a gate that summons a young, resurrected Isshin Ashina from death.
The Long-armed Centipede Giraffe is a mini boss in the Gun Fort whose body is driven by an internal centipede parasite, causing rapid jerking windmill-like attacks.
The Guardian Ape is an enormous primate sustained unnaturally by the rejuvenating waters, guarding the Lotus of the Palace, an ingredient Kuro needs for the severance ritual.
After Wolf decapitates the Guardian Ape, its headless body rises again, picks up its severed head and a sword, and continues attacking, driven by a centipede parasite inside it.

The Guardian Ape has a mate, a second, smaller and less corrupted ape, found in a hidden arena deep in the mountains, where she fights alongside the reanimated, headless corpse of the first Guardian Ape; when Wolf kills her, the headless first ape briefly cradles her body before resuming its attack.
The waters of rejuvenation transformed the Guardian Ape into something that cannot die but is no longer truly alive.
In the Purification ending's memory sequence, Wolf refights Owl at the Hirata Estate three years before the main game, facing him at the height of his power.
At the heart of the Fountain Head Palace, in a sky-open arena, the Divine Dragon resides, the entity whose essence poisoned the land of Ashina with immortality.
The Divine Dragon fight is framed as a ritual of release rather than a conventional battle, fought by catching and redirecting lightning at the dragon.
During the Interior Ministry's final invasion and the burning of Ashina Castle, the Sculptor transforms into the Demon of Hatred.
The Demon of Hatred retains the fused prosthetic arm of the Sculptor, now warped into a weapon of destructive fire power.
During the fight, using the finger whistle causes the Demon of Hatred to flinch and briefly show a flicker of human recognition before the rage returns.
In the Immortal Severance ending's final battle, Genichiro Ashina uses the Black Mortal Blade to open a gate to the underworld and summon the soul of young Isshin Ashina at the height of his power.
Young Isshin Ashina fights across three escalating phases: swordsmanship, then spear and firearm techniques, then lightning-infused combat.
After being defeated, young Isshin Ashina dies at peace, complimenting Wolf's skill rather than discussing Ashina's legacy.
